A pre and post training evaluation: participants rate their confidence, and say whether they would recommend the training, before and after it. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Paired samples t-test, Wilcoxon signed-rank test, McNemar test) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `paired`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

![The Design screen with the paired study.](../../templates/paired/design.png){width=100%}

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("paired")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Did confidence change from before to after the training? | Paired samples t-test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Did confidence change, without assuming normality? | Wilcoxon signed-rank test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Did willingness to recommend change? | McNemar test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
